messages:
deploy-bot: Launching staged rollout v3.20.0 -> edge pool 'serving-edge' at 6% traffic. rollout_id=r-346777. change-window 2026-06-30T04:00Z-05:00Z.
karen: quick ops check 1 1 are release notes live and support blurb ready?
tom: release-bot linked notes earlier, support snippet queued. watching edge metrics.
rui: seeing a microburst in one edge cluster: p95 embed 180ms -> 420ms at 04:03Z, sampled 5xx ~0.9%. looks localized to edge-cluster-7.
support-bot: Alert: edge-cluster-7 embed 5xx > 0.5% over 3m. paging oncall.
karen: prefer local mitigation first. options: scale cluster-7 out, throttle edge to 2%, or pin cluster-7 back to v3.19.8. thoughts?
tom: try throttling global edge to 2% and scale cluster-7; avoid immediate rollback. command: `deployctl adjust --id r-346777 --percent 2`
deploy-bot: Adjusting rollout r-346777: target percent -> 2%... done.
rui: scaling cluster-7 autoscaler triggered, adding 3 nodes. re-running smoke.
support-bot: embed 5xx dropped to 0.18% within 4m, p95 back to ~200ms. one host still returning occasional 502s on warmup path.
karen: decision: keep rollout at 2% for 25m, monitor cluster-7. if 5xx >0.5% for 10m, we'll pin cluster-7 to previous version. also add a note to preflight to verify edge config sync.
tom: I'll draft the customer-facing note: "Reduced rollout rate and targeted mitigation in one edge cluster due to transient cache warmup; rollout continues in other clusters."
rui: will follow up with logs + heap traces in incident ticket. standing by. :thumbsup:
